items.example: He refused to back down, even when he was wrong.
items.exampleTr: Haksız olsa bile geri adım atmayı reddetti.
items.simple: You stop saying you are right and let the other person win.

items.example: He blew up when he saw the mess.
items.simple: Something bursts, or someone gets very, very angry.

items.example: I need to brush up on my French before the trip.
items.simple: You study something you knew before so you remember it again.

items.example: They carried out the plan without any problems.
items.simple: You do a job or plan from the start to the end.

items.example: She'll come round once she's had time to think.
items.simple: Someone slowly agrees with you after saying no.

items.example: Our holiday plans fell through at the last minute.
items.exampleTr: Tatil planlarımız son anda suya düştü.
items.simple: A plan does not happen, even though you wanted it.

items.example: I couldn't get my point across to him.
items.simple: You say something so that the other person understands it.

items.example: She held back her tears during the speech.
items.simple: You stop yourself from showing a feeling or doing something.

items.example: I couldn't make out what he was saying.
items.simple: You can just about see or hear something that is not clear.

items.example: The doctors say he'll pull through.
items.simple: You get well again after a very hard time.

items.example: They called off the match because of the rain.
items.simple: You say a planned thing will not happen now.

items.example: He always gets away with being late.
items.simple: You do something wrong, but nobody punishes you.

items.example: Stop showing off in front of everyone!
items.simple: You do something so people say 'wow, you are good'.

items.example: Her red coat really stood out in the crowd.
items.exampleTr: Kırmızı paltosu kalabalıkta gerçekten göze çarpıyordu.
items.simple: You look or sound different, so people notice you.

items.example: Sorry, I zoned out for a second.
items.simple: You stop listening, and your mind is far away.

items.example: She's going through a really hard time.
items.simple: You have a bad time that is hard to live with.

items.example: My plans just fell apart.
items.simple: Something breaks into many pieces.

items.example: I can get by with a little English.
items.simple: You have just enough to live or do things.

items.example: I messed up my exam badly.
items.simple: You do something wrong and make it bad.

items.example: The doctor ruled out anything serious.
items.exampleTr: Doktor ciddi bir şey olmadığını belirledi.
items.simple: You say it cannot be true or cannot happen.

items.tr: gözden geçirmek, baştan sona prova etmek
items.example: Let's run through the plan once more.
items.exampleTr: Planı bir kez daha gözden geçirelim.
items.simple: You say or do the whole thing quickly from start to end.

items.example: He wants to settle down and have kids.
items.simple: You live a calm life in one place.

items.example: My teacher told me off for being late.
items.exampleTr: Öğretmenim geç kaldığım için beni azarladı.
items.simple: You say angry words to someone who did something wrong.
